In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8973):

>## Summary
>- Replaces `git clean -fx -- '*_mock.go'` with `find . -name '*_mock.go' -not -path './vendor/*' -delete` in the `generate` Makefile target
>- The `git clean` command conflicts with pre-commit's stash mechanism in CI, causing 10-20+ retry turns and wasting 15-20 minutes per jira-agent periodic run
>- `find -delete` achieves the same cleanup without interacting with git's index or stash machinery
>
>## Context
>Part of [CNTRLPLANE-3761](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/CNTRLPLANE-3761) — platform and harness reliability for the jira-agent periodic CI job. Investigation found this is the single largest bottleneck, responsible for ~70% of Phase 1 time waste.
>
>## Test plan
>- [ ] Verify `make generate` still cleans and regenerates mock files correctly
>- [ ] Run pre-commit hooks with pending changes to confirm no stash conflicts
>- [ ] Validate in a jira-agent rehearsal job
>

This confirms the full picture. The gitlint check has already **passed** on the newer commit (`55987a7`). The failure we're analyzing is from the original push that had a non-conventional commit message. # Test Failure Analysis Complete ## Job Information - **Prow Job**: gitlint / Gitlint - **Build ID**: 29031285491 / job 86164418281 - **PR**: #8973 — "[CNTRLPLANE-3761](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/CNTRLPLANE-3761): replace git clean with find for mock cleanup" - **Workflow**: `.github/workflows/gitlint-reusable.yaml` - **Commit (at trigger time)**: `117e471068af809f345013a350d700b560748006` ## Test Failure Analysis ### Error ``` 1: CT1 Title does not start with one of fix, feat, chore, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, revert, ci, build: "CNTRLPLANE-3761: replace git clean with find for mock cleanup" make: *** [Makefile:624: run-gitlint] Error 1 ``` ### Summary The gitlint check enforces [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) format via the `contrib-title-conventional-commits` rule. The commit message title on the original push (`117e471`) was `CNTRLPLANE-3761: replace git clean with find for mock cleanup`, which starts with a JIRA ticket ID instead of a required conventional commit type prefix. The author has already force-pushed a corrected commit (`55987a7`) with the title `fix: replace git clean with find for mock cleanup`, and the gitlint check **passes on the new commit**.
Root Cause The original commit pushed to PR #8973 used the JIRA-ticket-prefixed format `CNTRLPLANE-3761: replace git clean with find for mock cleanup` as the commit message title. The repository's `.gitlint` configuration enforces the Conventional Commits spec via `contrib=contrib-title-conventional-commits`, requiring titles to start with one of: `fix`, `feat`, `chore`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `revert`, `ci`, `build`. The string `CNTRLPLANE-3761` does not match any of the allowed prefixes, so gitlint rule CT1 rejected the commit. This is a commit message formatting issue — the JIRA ticket ID belongs in the commit body (where it was also placed), not as the title prefix. The author corrected this by force-pushing commit `55987a7fb4b` with the title `fix: replace git clean with find for mock cleanup`, which passes gitlint. The failed run (29031285491) is now stale — the newer run (29031491908) on commit `55987a7` shows gitlint as **passing**.
Recommendations 1. **No action needed** — the author has already fixed the commit message and the gitlint check passes on the latest push (`55987a7`). The failed check on run `29031285491` is stale. 2. **For future commits**: Always use Conventional Commits format for the title line (e.g., `fix:`, `feat:`, `chore:`). Place JIRA ticket IDs in the commit body, not the title prefix. 3. **Consider a local git hook**: The repo could add a `commit-msg` hook (or document the existing one) to validate the conventional commit format before push, catching this before CI.
Evidence | Evidence | Detail | |----------|--------| | Gitlint error | `CT1 Title does not start with one of fix, feat, chore, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, revert, ci, build: "[CNTRLPLANE-3761](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/CNTRLPLANE-3761): replace git clean with find for mock cleanup"` | | Failing commit SHA | `117e471068af809f345013a350d700b560748006` (original push) | | Failing commit title | `CNTRLPLANE-3761: replace git clean with find for mock cleanup` | | `.gitlint` config | `contrib=contrib-title-conventional-commits` with `types = fix,feat,chore,docs,style,refactor,perf,test,revert,ci,build` | | Corrected commit SHA | `55987a7fb4b580a215e40aec40d77cc1bc3a1a31` (force-push) | | Corrected commit title | `fix: replace git clean with find for mock cleanup` | | Newer gitlint run | Run 29031491908 on `55987a7` — **conclusion: success** |
---
